sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's live official tourism-board nationality table directly maps Zimbabwe to a visa obtained on arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Zimbabwe | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

sources.title: Suspension of Visa Issuance to Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The State Department's current PP 10998 notice names Zimbabwe in the partially suspended B-1/B-2 visitor-visa cohort and preserves valid-visa grandfathering, exceptions and case-by-case national-interest decisions.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38), geographical definition of United States
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.officialityEvidence: The official U.S. Code publication defines the United States for INA purposes to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands, and the Northern Mariana Islands.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

policies.title: Zimbabwean ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Zimbabwean visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Zimbabwean passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

The partial suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes the Northern Mariana Islands. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
